title: Add operator reply popup queue to CommandCenterUI
description: Add a keyboard-accessible AIM-style overlay that presents only new unanswered operator-directed hcom requests, approval gates, and terminal prompts. Preserve existing attention inbox and reply_to behavior. The operator must explicitly choose reply, open, snooze, dismiss, approve, or reject; no action may be automatic.
acceptance_criteria: New unanswered request messages, approval gates, and terminal prompts are queued into one operator-visible popup at a time without duplicating a popup for an item already seen.
Popup actions explicitly route to reply or open paths, persist snooze or dismissal locally, and retain the existing inbox; approval decisions remain explicit.
Focused UI checks verify popup markup, queue behavior, action wiring, and no automatic approval or send behavior.
